children.value: nāpekṣate bhaviṣyaṃ ca vartamāne na tiṣṭhati
na saṃsmaratyatītaṃ ca sarvameva karoti ca
suptaḥ prabuddho bhavati prabuddho'pi ca suptavān
sarvaṃ karma karotyantarna karoti ca kiṃcana

yā niśā
sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī iti bhagavadvacanam

vyavahāre
prabuddhaḥ kuśalatamo'pi suptavānevāste na tatkauśalaphalena rajyata ityarthaḥ
nābhivāñchati na dveṣṭi na śocati na hṛṣyati
bhakte bhaktasamācāraḥ śaṭhe śaṭha iva sthitaḥ
bālo bāleṣu vṛddheṣu vṛddho dhīreṣu dhairyavān
na tasya sukṛtenārtho na bhogairna ca karmabhiḥ
na duṣkṛtairna bhogānāṃ saṃtyāgena na bandhubhiḥ
na bandhena na mokṣeṇa na pātālena no divā
sarva sarvaprakāreṇa gṛhṇāti ca jahāti ca
kāryodaye naiti mudaṃ kāryanāśe na khidyate
na pramatto na khinnātmā nodvigno na ca harṣavān
kva kiledaṃ kutaḥ ko'taḥ prasaṅgaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ

kiṃca pratikṣaṇapariṇāmino hi sarve bhāvāḥ iti nyāyātpratikṣaṇaṃ
bhidyamāneṣu jagaddharmeṣvanuvartamānaḥ sthāyī sadātmā svapna iva
svātmanyeva dṛśyavān ṣaḍbhāvavikārānpratikṣaṇaṃ kalpayanpaśyatītyeva
teṣāṃ niścaye kuto harṣādiprasaktirityāśayenāha - nimeṣamityādinā
kīdṛśyaḥ kathamāyātāḥ kva vā tā duḥkhasaṃvidaḥ
āmūlānmanasi kṣīṇe saṃkalpasya kathā ca kā

cittaṃ prati svamudito vitataikarūpī
jñastiṣṭhati svapiti jīvati nityatṛptaḥ
